html: My journey: learning calligraphy → winning a silver prize at the national Shuanglong Cup painting and calligraphy competition for primary school pupils → letting it all slide and forgetting everything → throwing it all out and working it out for myself → restoring past glories → going abroad, and the keyboard barging in. That’s how it ended up like this. Reading the other answers, I feel utterly crushed. At school, though, I was always the one doing the blackboard bulletins and writing things out for people.
